three_step_associativity.detail: Zero violations over 68,921 three-morphism chains. EXEC-CM-01 could not reach this: two-step transport cannot exhibit an associativity failure.

loop_biconditional.detail: Over 21,853 closed loops the declared round trip is the identity on every object exactly when every square in the cycle commutes -- zero violations in either direction. 1,681 commute and 20,172 do not, so both sides were exercised and the biconditional is not vacuously satisfied.

path_dependence.detail: 7,140 of 8,000 same-endpoint route pairs transport at least one object differently. Path dependence is the phenomenon T13 is about, and a grid without it could not test the theorem -- that condition was frozen as a negative before the run.

comparator.detail: 7,140 failures. The donor declares routes equivalent whenever their endpoints match; T13 says the route matters, so a donor that never failed would have meant the enumeration never produced path dependence.

what_this_does_not_establish: Nothing beyond the declared grid: 2 coordinates, 3 values, a 40-morphism sample of the full morphism space. The morphism space is sampled rather than exhausted, so loop and chain claims are over the sampled class.
No proof-assistant correspondence; EXEC-PA-01 remains open.
No external adjudication. Runner and checker are two implementations inside one programme.
